About the Team
DoorDash Drive powers deliveries placed through merchants' own channels—including their websites, mobile apps, and phone orders—using DoorDash's logistics network. The Drive Machine Learning team builds the prediction and intelligence systems that power this business, including delivery and pickup time estimation, merchant prep-time prediction, order release optimization, logistics decision-making, and AI-powered delivery quality signals.
Drive presents a unique machine learning challenge. Every merchant has different operational workflows, preparation patterns, and customer expectations, requiring models that generalize across millions of deliveries while adapting to highly diverse merchant behavior. Our team has significant opportunities to improve prediction accuracy, optimize logistics decisions, and build AI-native experiences that directly improve merchant, consumer, and dasher outcomes.
About the Role
As a Machine Learning Engineer on the Drive team, you'll own machine learning systems end-to-end—from feature engineering and model development to experimentation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous iteration.
Your work will span several high-impact problem areas:
Build next-generation machine learning models for delivery ETA, pickup ETA, merchant prep-time estimation, and order release prediction that improve reliability for merchants and consumers.
Develop deep learning models that leverage large-scale spatiotemporal, marketplace, and behavioral signals to improve prediction accuracy.
Apply reinforcement learning and optimization techniques to improve logistics decision-making, assignment strategies, and marketplace efficiency.
Build AI-native product experiences using large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). For example, transform pickup photos, item verification flows, receipts, and drop-off images into structured quality signals that help verify orders, prevent delivery defects, and improve issue resolution.
Design and run rigorous online experiments, production monitoring, and model iteration to continuously improve performance.
Partner closely with software engineers, product managers, data scientists, and platform teams to bring new machine learning capabilities into production at scale.
You'll have the opportunity to work across traditional machine learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning, optimization, and multimodal AI while solving some of the most challenging logistics problems at DoorDash.

You enjoy solving large-scale machine learning problems that directly impact millions of deliveries.
You have a strong sense of ownership and enjoy taking models from research through production.
You're comfortable working in ambiguous environments where experimentation and iteration drive product decisions.
You care about both model quality and production reliability.
You're excited to work across a diverse set of ML techniques—from neural networks and optimization to multimodal AI.
You collaborate well across engineering, product, and data science teams.

5+ years of industry experience building and shipping production machine learning systems with measurable business impact (Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD).

Deep Learning

Large Language Models (LLMs) or Vision-Language Models (VLMs)
Experience applying machine learning to estimation, ranking, prediction, optimization, or decision-making problems at production scale.
Hands-on experience with LLMs or VLMs is a strong plus.
Experience in logistics, marketplaces, or delivery platforms is helpful but not required.
Proficiency using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) throughout the software development lifecycle.

jobs.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We're looking for a highly motivated, self-starter Strategic Account Executive who is passionate about voice technology and how it is changing businesses. We don't just sell a product or custom-level solutions; we are partnering with our strategic enterprises to help them generate new experiences and monetisation opportunities at scale with our breakthrough voice technology. In this role you will: - Build and manage a growing portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts in the Saudi Arabia to help ElevenLabs meet its revenue goals. - Identify and develop high-value business opportunities that align with ElevenLabs' product offering and roadmap. - Generate leads, negotiate complex contracts and close sales in collaboration with the Growth team. - Be responsible for KPI and sales performance tracking, providing weekly updates to the wider ElevenLabs team. Who you are We're looking for exceptional individuals who combine technical excellence with ethical awareness, who are excited by hard problems and motivated by human impact. You'll strive with us if you: - Are passionate about audio AI driven by a desire to make content universally accessible and breaking the frontiers of new tech. - Are a highly motivated and driven individual with a strong work ethic. Our team is aware of this critical moment of audio AI evolution and is committed to going the extra mile to lead. - Are analytical, efficient, and strive on solving complex challenges with a first principles mindset. - Consistently strive for excellence, delivering high-quality work quickly and exceeding expectations. - Take initiative and work autonomously from day one, prioritizing learning and contribution while leaving ego aside. What you bring - Proven track record of meeting & exceeding sales targets in a fast-paced environment, selling into large and strategic enterprises in the Saudi Arabia - +10 years of previous experience in sales in a SaaS organisation, with experience managing strategic, complex, deal cycles. - Extensive experience working in the Saudi Arabia - Expertise or willingness to learn everything about Voice AI industry and how ElevenLabs' solution can help. - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders at all levels of an organization. - A hybrid of customer & product-driven mentality that prioritises client impact, satisfaction & scale. - The role is based in the Saudi Arabia - Plus: Proficiency in Arabic. #LI-remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.description: Job Description Summary Nous sommes à la recherche d'un chef de projet principal pour diriger la réalisation de projets complexes de sous-stations au sein de l'activité Intégration des systèmes de réseau de GE Vernova. À ce poste, vous coordonnerez plusieurs sous-projets et flux de travail, en assurant la cohérence entre l'ingénierie, les achats, la fabrication, la construction, la mise en service et les activités des clients. Vous serez responsable du pilotage de l'exécution des projets, de la planification à la livraison, en centralisant les informations sur l'avancement, les risques et les priorités dans une vision globale claire. Ce poste exige également d'excellentes compétences interpersonnelles et une communication efficace avec la direction, ainsi qu'une collaboration étroite avec les équipes internes et les intervenants externes afin d'assurer la réalisation des objectifs du projet en toute sécurité, dans les délais impartis, en respectant le budget et les exigences contractuelles et de qualité. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- We are looking for a Senior Project Manager to lead the execution of complex substation projects within GE Vernova’s Grid Systems Integration business. In this role, you will coordinate multiple sub-projects and workstreams, ensuring alignment across engineering, procurement, manufacturing, construction, commissioning, and customer-facing activities. You will be responsible for driving project execution from planning through delivery, while consolidating progress, risks, and priorities into a clear overall project view. The role also requires strong reporting and communication with leadership, as well as close collaboration with internal teams and external stakeholders to ensure project objectives are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and in line with quality and contractual requirements. Job Description Résumé du poste : Le chef de projet principal est responsable de la conduite de projets de sous-stations complexes et de grande envergure au sein de l'activité Intégration des systèmes de réseau (GSI) de GE Vernova. Ces projets impliquent la coordination de plusieurs sous-projets interreliés au sein d'un plan de réalisation intégré. Ce rôle consiste à consolider et à soutenir les activités des différentes équipes (ingénierie, approvisionnement, fabrication, construction, mise en service et relations clients) afin de garantir la conformité à la portée, au calendrier, aux coûts, à la qualité et aux engagements contractuels. Outre la gestion de l'ensemble des activités de gestion de projet, le/la gestionnaire de projet principal assure la liaison entre les équipes d'exécution et la direction. Il/Elle assure une gouvernance structurée, des rapports fiables, une visibilité des risques et une remontée rapide des renseignements sur les problèmes qui ont un impact sur la réalisation des projets. Ce poste requiert une grande capacité de coordination interfonctionnelle, une connaissance approfondie de l'exécution des projets de sous-stations et la capacité de traduire les données détaillées relatives à la performance du projet en informations claires et en outils d'aide à la décision pour la direction interne et les parties prenantes externes. Responsabilités essentielles : Effectuer un examen de la portée du projet et le comparer au devis de GEV lors du transfert du dossier de projet du service commercial à la gestion de projet. Animer la réunion de lancement du projet avec tous les contributeurs internes et attribuer les rôles et responsabilités. Animer la réunion de lancement avec le client afin de communiquer la nature du travail à effectuer et de clarifier tout point relatif à la commande. Gérer l'exécution globale de projets complexes de sous-stations, en veillant à leur livraison conformément au périmètre contractuel, au calendrier, au budget, aux exigences de qualité et de sécurité. Consolider et coordonner les activités des différents sous-projets et flux de travail, afin de créer une vision intégrée du projet et d'assurer l'alignement des priorités, des jalons, des dépendances et des livrables. Diriger la planification et l'exécution du projet pour les activités d'ingénierie, d'approvisionnement, de production, de logistique, de construction, de mise en service et de transfert. Établir et maintenir une gouvernance de projet efficace, incluant les revues de projet, le suivi des actions, les registres de décisions, la gestion des escalades et les rapports de direction. Suivre la performance du projet par rapport aux indicateurs clés et identifier, évaluer et atténuer de manière proactive les risques, les problèmes, les retards et les impacts sur les coûts susceptibles d'affecter la réussite du projet. Accompagner les responsables de sous-projets et les équipes fonctionnelles dans la résolution des difficultés transversales, la levée des obstacles à l'exécution et le maintien de la concentration sur les activités critiques. Gérer la communication avec les clients et la coordination des intervenants afin d'assurer la transparence, l'alignement et la résolution rapide des problèmes techniques, commerciaux et liés à l'exécution. Assurer la conformité aux exigences contractuelles, aux processus internes, aux normes de qualité et aux exigences réglementaires et de sécurité applicables tout au long du cycle de vie du projet. Piloter les activités de gestion du changement, notamment l'évaluation des modifications de périmètre, des répercussions sur le calendrier et les coûts, ainsi que les approbations ou notifications des clients associées. Préparer et présenter à la direction des mises à jour précises et opportunes sur l'état d'avancement du projet, des prévisions et des synthèses, en mettant en évidence le rendement, les risques, les décisions requises et les mesures correctives, le cas échéant. Favoriser une culture de responsabilité, de collaboration et d'amélioration continue au sein de l'équipe de projet et des fonctions d'interface. Soutenir les activités de clôture de projet, y compris les livrables finaux, les leçons apprises, la clôture financière et la transition vers les phases de garantie ou de service, le cas échéant. Qualifications requises : Baccalauréat en génie, commerce, opérations ou dans un domaine connexe. Au moins 5 ans d'expérience en gestion de projet pertinente pour le poste, de préférence dans les sous-stations, les infrastructures de réseau, l'énergie ou d'autres projets industriels importants et complexes. Déplacements jusqu'à 15 % selon les besoins de l'entreprise Expérience confirmée en gestion de projets complexes et multidisciplinaires dans des environnements internationaux et transversaux Solides connaissances des méthodologies, des outils et des cadres de gouvernance de gestion de projet Expérience de la collaboration avec des intervenants mondiaux ou régionaux au sein d'organisations matricielles Capacité de diriger avec structure et réactivité, en gérant les priorités concurrentes tout en assurant une exécution cohérente Communication claire et efficace avec les équipes, les clients et la direction Conception de cadres évolutifs et anticipation des besoins opérationnels avant qu'ils ne deviennent des obstacles Analyse des causes profondes, gestion de l'ambiguïté et mise en œuvre de solutions pratiques et concrètes Utilisation des données, des indicateurs et des tendances pour éclairer les décisions et mesurer l'impact Capacité à mener le changement organisationnel, à obtenir l'adhésion des intervenants et à favoriser l'adoption au sein d'équipes diverses La maîtrise du français est un atout Qualifications souhaitées : Diplôme d'études supérieures ou certifications pertinentes (p. ex., PMP, Lean, Six Sigma) souhaités. Une expérience dans le domaine des projets de sous-stations ou de réseaux électriques est un atout majeur. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Role Summary: The Senior Project Manager is responsible for leading the execution of large, complex substation projects within GE Vernova’s Grid Systems Integration (GSI) business, where multiple interdependent sub-projects must be coordinated into one integrated delivery plan. This role consolidates and supports activities across engineering, procurement, manufacturing, construction, commissioning, and customer interface workstreams to ensure alignment on scope, schedule, cost, quality, and contract commitments. In addition to managing the full range of project management activities, the Senior Project Manager serves as a critical link between project execution teams and leadership, providing structured governance, reliable reporting, risk visibility, and timely escalation of issues affecting delivery. The role requires strong cross-functional coordination, deep understanding of substation project execution, and the ability to translate detailed project performance into clear insights and decision support for internal leadership and external stakeholders. Essential Responsibilities: Perform Project scope review and compare with the GEV quote upon transfer of the project file from the Commercial group to Project management. Lead the project kick-off meeting with all internal contributors and assign roles and responsibilities. Lead the customer kick-off meeting to communicate the nature of the work that will be done and clarify any issues in the order. Lead the overall execution of complex substation projects, ensuring delivery in line with contractual scope, schedule, budget, quality, and safety requirements. Consolidate and coordinate activities across multiple sub-projects and workstreams, creating an integrated project view and ensuring alignment of priorities, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables. Drive project planning and execution across engineering, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, construction, commissioning, and handover activities. Establish and maintain effective project governance, including project reviews, action tracking, decision logs, escalation management, and leadership reporting. Monitor project performance against key metrics and proactively identify, assess, and mitigate risks, issues, delays, and cost impacts that could affect successful delivery. Support sub-project leaders and functional teams in resolving cross-functional challenges, removing execution barriers, and maintaining focus on critical path activities. Manage customer communication and stakeholder coordination to ensure transparency, alignment, and timely resolution of technical, commercial, and execution-related matters. Ensure compliance with contract requirements, internal processes, quality standards, and applicable regulatory and safety expectations throughout the project lifecycle. Lead change management activities, including evaluation of scope changes, schedule impacts, cost implications, and associated approvals or customer notifications. Prepare and deliver accurate, timely project status updates, forecasts, and executive summaries to leadership, highlighting performance, risks, decisions required, and recovery actions where needed. Drive a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement across the project team and interfacing functions. Support project closing activities, including final deliverables, lessons learned, financial closure, and transition to warranty or service phases where applicable. Required Qualifications: Bachelors degree in engineering, business, operations, or a related field is required. Minimum 5 years of project management experience relevant to the role, preferably in substations, grid infrastructure, energy, or other large and complex industrial projects. Up to 15% travel based on the business needs Proven experience managing complex, multi-workstream projects across cross-functional and international environments Strong grounding in project management methodologies, tools, and governance frameworks Experience engaging global or regional stakeholders in matrixed organizations Leads with structure and urgency — balancing competing priorities while driving consistent execution Communicates with clarity across teams, customers, and senior leadership Designs scalable frameworks and anticipates operational needs before they become obstacles Diagnoses root causes, navigates ambiguity, and delivers practical, actionable solutions Uses data, metrics, and trends to inform decisions and measure impact Skilled at driving organizational change — building stakeholder buy-in and leading adoption across diverse teams French language proficiency is an asset Preferred Qualifications: Advanced degree or relevant certifications (e.g., PMP, Lean, Six Sigma) preferred. Experience in substation or grid project environments is a strong advantage. This role requires access to U.S. export-controlled information. If applicable, final offers will be contingent on ability to obtain authorization for access to U.S. export-controlled information from the U.S. Government. ​ Additional Information GE Vernova offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. The EMEA Regional Finance Team serves as the strategic and operational finance partner for KKR’s offices and operating entities across EMEA. Partnering with the deal teams, London Finance and central FPA teams in order to provide timely and accurate analytics to support business decision-making by regional senior management.
Prepare monthly and quarterly Board Packs on legal entity financial management information packs for senior stakeholders, including expense analysis.
Support the EMEA CFO with ad hoc analysis, regional finance priorities, cost management initiatives and strategic projects requiring strong financial judgement and cross-functional coordination.
Track, monitor and report to Business heads on expenses, cost allocations and business performance metrics to support cost management and financial discipline across the region.

Financial Accounting & Audits
Prepare and support month-end and year-end close processes, under both local GAAP and IFRS accounting standards, across several management companies inclusive of posting and reviewing journals, performing and documenting key profit and loss and balance sheet reconciliations, IFRS 2 share-based payment accounting charges, and revenue recognition activities.

Reconciliations between KKR’s ledgers and those of its local service providers for certain EMEA management companies.

Own and drive the end-to-end architectural vision for Roblox's core data platforms spanning Kafka, Flink, Spark, Trino, Druid, Airflow, and Data Catalog systems. Turn multi-year company strategies into concrete, production-grade infrastructure blueprints.

Deep-dive into distributed engine internals, complex query planning, state management, serialization efficiency, and advanced memory optimization techniques to maximize throughput and cost-efficiency under peak compute loads.

Spearhead the integration of advanced AI/ML capabilities and large language models (LLMs) within our core data platform to deliver self-serve data discovery, automated metadata generation, and intelligent autonomous interaction layers.

Expert-level mastery and a deep history of building with foundational data technologies within our tech stack: Kafka, Flink, Spark, Trino, Druid, Hive, Airflow, or advanced Data Catalog / Metadata systems.

A proven track record of architecting, writing, and deploying core data platform code and distributed systems from the ground up. Robust proficiency in

Proven expertise managing, scaling, and troubleshooting complex stateful and stateless multi-cluster data infrastructure running on top of Kubernetes within AWS or GCP.

A proven track record of influencing technical direction across a large engineering organization, leading consensus on complex architectural initiatives, and championing successful multi-quarter projects.

A history of radical accountability. You do not wait for clean specifications in high-ambiguity environments; you actively define the technical requirements, unblock dependencies, rally engineers across pods, and steer complex projects from initial whiteboard sketch all the way to production stability.

Contributions to open-source projects in the data infrastructure ecosystem.
Experience operating infrastructure at consumer-internet scale (100M+ users).
